label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, _____ me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verse: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
note: The thief's request on the cross — and Jesus' answer comes in the very next verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For a small _____ have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verse: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
note: Forsaken for a small moment, gathered with great mercies — the sorrow is short, the mercy is great.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The _____ are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verse: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
note: Small but smart: the ants aren't strong, yet they stock up their food in summer.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little _____ out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verse: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
note: After three and a half years of drought, Elijah's servant spots a hand-sized cloud — then the sky turns black.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And God sent me before you to preserve you a _____ in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verse: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
note: Joseph to the brothers who sold him: God sent me ahead 'to preserve you a posterity' — providence reframing betrayal.
